title: This week …
excerpt: I had a great day with UCC folks in Vero Beach, FL, on Friday – then have been with some churches in MD this weekend, and tomorrow begins the long-awaited CYNKC conference in DC … exciting days, with the added joy of being with family, including my granddaughter. I’m a happy guy!
